zh.CHANNELS.SPLIT_AUDIO.SYNC_BAR.FAILED.fau: Sync stopped because the sound had a fault.
zh.CHANNELS.SPLIT_AUDIO.SYNC_BAR.FAILED.int: Sync cancelled by pause, seek or reload. Press Sync to start again.
zh.CHANNELS.SPLIT_AUDIO.SYNC_BAR.FAILED.no-: Not synced: the match clocks could not be read.

zh.CHANNELS.SPLIT_AUDIO.SYNC_BAR.VOIDED.fau: The manual correction was cancelled by a sound fault. It was not applied again; press Apply again to resume it.
zh.CHANNELS.SPLIT_AUDIO.SYNC_BAR.VOIDED.pau: The manual correction was cancelled by a pause. It was not applied again; press Apply again to resume it.
zh.CHANNELS.SPLIT_AUDIO.SYNC_BAR.VOIDED.rel: The manual correction was cancelled by a reload. It was not applied again; press Apply again to resume it.

zh.CHANNELS.SPLIT_AUDIO.SYNC_MODE.QUICK_HIN: Jumps the leading side back by the difference. Only when you press it.
zh.CHANNELS.SPLIT_AUDIO.SYNC_MODE.SUMMARY_A: Audio is ahead by {{seconds}}s: the audio will be slowed gradually.
zh.CHANNELS.SPLIT_AUDIO.SYNC_MODE.SUMMARY_P: Picture is ahead by {{seconds}}s: the picture will be slowed gradually.
zh.CHANNELS.SPLIT_AUDIO.SYNC_MODE.TARGET: Target offset (the correction aims at it)

zh.EMBEDDED_MPV.PLAYER.STATS_HINT_AUDIO: How the sound is compressed, and the data it uses each second.
zh.EMBEDDED_MPV.PLAYER.STATS_HINT_AUDIO_CHA: How many sound channels the stream carries (stereo, 5.1, ...).
zh.EMBEDDED_MPV.PLAYER.STATS_HINT_BUFFER: Seconds of video already downloaded ahead of what you are watching. Close to zero means it may stall.
zh.EMBEDDED_MPV.PLAYER.STATS_HINT_CONTAINER: The packaging format that carries the picture and the sound.
zh.EMBEDDED_MPV.PLAYER.STATS_HINT_DECODER: Hardware uses the graphics chip and keeps the processor free; software uses the processor.
zh.EMBEDDED_MPV.PLAYER.STATS_HINT_DISPLAYED: The size the picture is shown at. It differs for streams with non-square pixels.
zh.EMBEDDED_MPV.PLAYER.STATS_HINT_DROPPED_F: Pictures the player skipped because it could not keep up. A few at the start are normal.
zh.EMBEDDED_MPV.PLAYER.STATS_HINT_FRAME_RAT: Pictures per second actually being shown. Higher is smoother.
zh.EMBEDDED_MPV.PLAYER.STATS_HINT_NETWORK_B: How much data is arriving from the network right now. A little above the picture and sound rates is normal because of packaging overhead.
zh.EMBEDDED_MPV.PLAYER.STATS_HINT_NOMINAL_F: The rate the stream announces. It can differ from the measured one.
zh.EMBEDDED_MPV.PLAYER.STATS_HINT_RESOLUTIO: The real size of the picture in the stream, in pixels.
zh.EMBEDDED_MPV.PLAYER.STATS_HINT_SAMPLE_RA: How finely the sound is sampled. 48 kHz is the usual value.
zh.EMBEDDED_MPV.PLAYER.STATS_HINT_STREAM_BI: The rate the stream announces. Rely on the measured picture and sound rates, not on this one.
zh.EMBEDDED_MPV.PLAYER.STATS_HINT_VIDEO: How the picture is compressed, and the data it uses each second (measured from the stream).
zh.EMBEDDED_MPV.PLAYER.STATS_NOTE: Measured from the live stream; nothing is taken from the playlist or the channel name. A row is left out when the player cannot measure it.
